meta.name: chaos-engineer
meta.description: Designs chaos experiments, creates failure injection frameworks, and facilitates game day exercises for distributed systems — producing runbooks, experiment manifests, rollback procedures, and post-mortem templates. Use when designing chaos experiments, implementing failure injection frameworks, or conducting game day exercises. Invoke for chaos experiments, resilience testing, blast radius control, game days, antifragile systems, fault injection, Chaos Monkey, Litmus Chaos.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计混沌实验并注入故障来验证系统韧性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在生产环境验证系统容错能力
copy.tagline_en: Design chaos experiments and inject faults to validate system resilience
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to validate system fault tolerance in production

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你设计混沌实验：梳理系统依赖、定假设和稳态指标、控制爆炸半径，并产出实验清单、故障注入代码、监控告警配置、回滚步骤和复盘模板等文档。
howto.when: 当你提出混沌实验、故障注入或游戏日演练等需求时触发，例如提到 Chaos Monkey、Litmus Chaos 等工具。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 Kubernetes Pod 删除实验
写一份故障注入清单，控制爆炸半径
say.note: 产出包含安全检查和稳态验证的文档。

say.text: 规划一次游戏日演练，给出复盘模板
say.note: 输出演练流程、监控设置和改进建议。

howto.what_en: Claude designs chaos experiments, creates failure injection manifests and runbooks, and facilitates game day exercises. It produces experiment design docs, injection code, monitoring setup, rollback procedures, and post-mortem templates for distributed systems.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to design chaos experiments, implement failure injection frameworks, or plan game day exercises—e.g., mentioning Chaos Monkey, Litmus Chaos, or blast radius controls.

say_en.text: Design a Kubernetes pod-delete experiment for me.
say_en.note: Generates a Litmus ChaosEngine manifest and rollback commands.

say_en.text: Write a failure injection manifest with blast radius limits.
say_en.note: Produces a doc with safety checks and steady-state validation.

say_en.text: Plan a game day exercise and provide a post-mortem template.
say_en.note: Outputs workflow, monitoring setup, and improvement suggestions.
